last_scene.summary: After the audience vote showed swordsmen as the largest single fighter group, Arlequino opened the official concert with his adapted 'Головы с плеч'. Returning listeners joined the chorus early; sword fighters answered the repeated sword/heads refrain loudly; 'Сильна Карионова ярость / С врагами зверолюди!' drew strong local approval; 'человечья кровь и гарь' split the crowd, with some younger fighters cheering while older listeners and a human trader reacted more grimly; 'Воля! Порядок! Вечная брань!' became a shouted call-response; the line about princely money and driving enemies out drew scattered laughter and argument rather than universal agreement; the final 'Все головы с плеч!' produced the loudest collective shout. Some non-fighters watched without joining and a few continued private conversations. Real-world discussion of the original song also describes it as notably divisive/ambiguous, supporting heterogeneous reactions rather than one universal response. Tips: +18s72c; expenses 0; net +18s72c.
